name: Mirror Lake Orchard
summary: Defias bandits now hold Mirror Lake Orchard on Mirror Lake’s southern shore in western Elwynn Forest. With Stormwind’s guards stretched thin, the grove near Thunder Falls lies exposed.

sections.title: A Grove Under Seizure
sections.body: Mirror Lake’s clean waters once sustained the farmstead. Now outlaws across Elwynn seek shelter in rural homes. The orchard’s cottage and grounds give the Defias Brotherhood a place to hide near Thunder Falls.

faq.q: Who controls Mirror Lake Orchard right now?
aliases: who is at mirror lake orchard
faq.answer: Defias bandits occupy Mirror Lake Orchard and its cottage. They drove away the honest folk who tended the trees, and now use the secluded grounds as a base in western Elwynn.

faq.q: Where is Mirror Lake Orchard located?
faq.answer: Mirror Lake Orchard lies on Mirror Lake’s southern shore in western Elwynn Forest, just east of Thunder Falls and north of the main road toward Westfall.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind reclaimed the orchard?
faq.answer: Stormwind’s standing army is largely absent from rural Elwynn amid political deadlock and the mysterious disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. Local garrisons are short-handed, so distant farms and orchards are often left to face the Defias Brotherhood alone.

faq.q: What is the connection between the orchard and Thunder Falls?
faq.answer: Mirror Lake drains into Thunder Falls, and the orchard sits just above the cascade. Its secluded position near the cliffs gives bandits a defensible place.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers, the occupied orchard is another sign of the Defias Brotherhood’s bold advance across the kingdom’s heartland.
As a Rogue, you can see the Defias strategy at the orchard: seize overlooked, defensible ground near water and cliffs to watch the roads and evade city patrols.
